svg.text: Generated from hw/board.yaml by hw/kicad_gen.py. Blue: ring ribbons on In2.Cu; orange: second half of bent hops on In5.Cu; pink: core-rail islands on In8.Cu. Memory, PCIe and management nets are unrouted.
